title: Implement Planning lifecycle composition issues

intent.outcome: Implement #2345, #2590, #2729, and #2765 as one independently reviewable Planning lifecycle-composition PR: disjoint owner integration makes progress without weakening same-owner conflicts, archive-owner integration carries canonical subject proof directly into atomic closeout, admitted material external observations reconcile stale selected-owner actions, and the Workspace reconcile facade cannot drift from the canonical Planning operation it projects.
non_goals: Do not redesign Planning integration proposals, closeout, owner admission, or the operating-decision architecture.
Do not treat integration or external completion as behavior proof, intent satisfaction, or issue closure authority.
Do not copy the Planning CLI by hand into Workspace or reopen the broad generated-command programme in #892.
Do not encode GitHub PR vocabulary, the captured stack shape, or one provider command as portable package semantics.
Do not implement #2725, #2762, #2763, #2562, or #2721 in this slice.

parent.contribution: Provides the executable, proof-bearing, owner-scoped lifecycle foundation consumed by later verifier, enforcement, delegation, and parent-closeout lanes.
parent.closure_boundary: This slice may close only #2345, #2590, #2729, and #2765; decomposition open-issues-2026-08-27 and parents #2562/#2721 remain open.

owned: focused conformance fixtures, release changeset, and dogfood evidence required by the four issue completion rules
effects: Planning integration apply may classify and apply an admitted disjoint owner subset while preserving skipped stale proposals with exact recovery.
Integration receipts and closeout admission share canonical subject-proof identities without promoting transition success into proof.
Startup/summary routing may reconcile a stale observation-dependent owner action only from a fresh admitted provider-neutral observation.
Workspace Planning command projection derives supported reconcile arguments and recovery rendering from canonical operation authority.

refs: Planning and Workspace lint/typecheck targets passed
generated command package local, Node, conformance, Docker, and Docker-conformance proofs passed

delegation.reason: Host instructions do not authorize sub-agent delegation for this task; the selected current target can implement the bounded first lane directly, and the lane itself must preserve verifier independence without delegating implementation authority.

next_action: Address blocking review feedback, obtain a current-head independent review, then merge PR #2766 before integrating the next stacked layer.

claims: A Workspace-rendered Planning reconcile action is executable through the named route and cannot drift from the canonical operation argument contract.
Eligible disjoint owner integrations make progress while stale unrelated proposals remain untouched and visible; same-owner conflicts still fail closed.
An archive-owner result carrying admitted subject proof is directly closeout-consumable, while missing/stale/mismatched proof and failed closeout are exact and transactionally non-mutating.
A fresh admitted material external observation deterministically removes an obsolete owner action from ordinary routing without treating external completion as intent or proof authority.
requirements: Add failing-before/passing-after unit and conformance fixtures for each issue reproduction and each required provider-neutral counterexample.
Run focused Planning integration, closeout, runtime projection, Workspace CLI, Planning help, and summary tests.
Regenerate and compare Python/TypeScript Planning and Workspace command/operation surfaces.
Run the routed implement/proof command with the exact changed paths.
Run workspace-wide lint, typecheck, tests, package-artifact checks, and maintained captured lifecycle replays.
Publish one non-draft PR based on master with exact issue closing metadata, hosted CI/Security/Semver checks, and no self-review authority.

continuation.residual_intent: After this lane lands, continue verifier authority, generic enforcement, non-local delegation, and final parent closure in dependency order.

execution_bounds.branch_order: codex/open-issues-lifecycle-composition-v2 is the first PR and bases on master; later lane PRs base on its exact head.
execution_bounds.ask_before: Changing public issue scope, adding a new top-level command or durable authority surface, merging or force-pushing a PR branch, or changing independent-review eligibility.
execution_bounds.stop_conditions: Stop if a maintained reproduction contradicts an issue outcome, canonical operation derivation requires broad #892 redesign, provider-neutral external observation cannot be separated from GitHub semantics, or the four issues cannot remain one independently testable lane.
